messages.subject: Issues viewing image in FieldImageR.Extra
parts:
Hello

I am having issues displaying some images in FieldImageR.Extra.

The error I am getting is :
> fieldView(Test)
[1] "Starting analysis ..."
[1] "Your 'mosaic' is too large and downsapling is being applied."
for stars_proxy objects, downsampling only happens for dimensions x and y
Error in if (project & !sf::st_is_longlat(x)) { :
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

I am able to view other images (all generated using DJI Terra) and this works fine suggesting the is an issue/ something missing in the image file?

The image also loads OK if I use the plotRGB(Test) method

Any suggestions on what I could be missing would be appreciated.

Thanks
Martin

Hello Martin.
Thanks for pointing out the error with the FIELDimageR.Extra package. Could you provide more information about the orthomosaic such as numbers of bands, coordinate reference system, etc? The information provided is not enough for a clear understanding of the issue.
Providing a portion of the orthomosaic, rather than the entire image (if it is big file), would be helpful for a clearer understanding of the issue. It'll help us fix any bugs.
